content:
Going forward, Palomar will require all new registrations to be using v4.35.0-rc2 or later.

Apologies if this inconveniences some, but I want to move to the new lake check infrastructure as soon as possible, without the overhead of maintaining multiple CI pathways.
Thanks for the update Kim, when would this be enforced?

My project, which started in February 2026, uses then latest v4.27.0. I tried to submit this project today but the verification failed due to the v4.35.0-rc2 floor. When I update from v4.27.0 to a later version, the compiled formalization runs into errors (e.g., non-trivial dependencies issues (in proofwidgets)). Any way around?

It sounds to me (just an outside person) that the way forward is to make your project build in 4.35.0. (proofwidgets issues have seen a deeper fix a few months ago; I don't remember if this was before or after 4.27.0. What should definitely work is deleting your .lake directory, re-getting the cache and rebuilding your project.)

Thanks so much!! The greenhorn me did not update the toml file and also did not "lake update" before removing the .lake dir. (May be it is a consequence of working 6 months with the same version.) Hopefully this update has no negative impact on the project code downstream.
